thoughts: The existing 'Blueprint' layout successfully captured user attention (demonstrated by the 26s dwell time), but the visual execution remains somewhat boxed-in and static. By evolving into a 'FORENSIC_GRID', we can transform the section into a high-fidelity technical dashboard that feels more 'precision-engineered'. The balance will be maintained by flanking a central 'Neural Core' with modular evidence items, creating a symmetrical flow that aligns with the center-weighted Hero above. High dwell time is likely due to the interactive hover states; I will amplify this by adding real-time data visualization effects in the visual_code, while introducing social proof (testimonials) to translate that dwell time into high-trust conversion signals.
